**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Stop source iteration after restoring a reached limit**

When `--limit` was reached at a committed packet boundary before an interruption, the restored count enters this branch and `continue` processes subsequent source metadata even though no more rows are read. An uninterrupted run instead breaks the outer loop immediately after reaching the limit, so resuming can add `wikidata-food-businesses` to `sources` and alter coverage fields and final manifest bytes. Break out of the source loop here to preserve byte-identical benchmark output.
